race.comment: CHOUX SHOE (5) bounced back last start on the quick turnaround, finishing nicely as the race favourite to finish 1.7L off the winner. Pike remains in the saddle here in a race that looks to shape similarly. Getting back to his best form now and she can get back to winning ways. RAINLINE (1) missed by 1L two back before winning at Kalgoorlie last time, scoring by 1L. Nottle hops back on board and her claim comes in handy and she looks to get every chance from the draw. Can play a leading role once again. JAZALOT (3) won in a photo two back and that form has stood up, as well as his last start effort at Pinjarra where he was beaten 1.3L. Recent form stacks right up and he can make his presence felt. DARK AVALANCHE (7) disappointed last time but was in good touch prior. Can bounce back to his best. BUNDABERG (6) can feature again with the fresh run under his belt.
